description: Test a company's strategy, moat and pitch through the lens of how Peter Thiel argues, built from 52 short sourced excerpts from the WSJ essay "Competition Is for Losers", his Stanford CS183B lecture, Zero to One and interviews. Use when the user asks for the Thiel view, for "why won't the incumbent or the platform owner eat us", "what is our moat", "what is our secret", for market definition and first-market choice, and next to jobs-lens and musk-lens on deck and investor answers about defensibility. Independent framework, not affiliated with or endorsed by Peter Thiel.
